verdict.rationale: Linear supports OAuth2 apps and personal API keys for authentication (linear-docs-50, linear-docs-88, linear-docs-99). Agent apps request named OAuth scopes such as app:assignable and app:mentionable (linear-docs-94). Admins can review and approve third-party apps before they are installed (linear-docs-73). This shows scoped, app-specific credentials for agents exist, but the evidence never shows least-privilege controls beyond those agent scopes. missing for 10: documented read/write or resource-level scope catalog, scoped or restricted personal API keys, team-limited credentials, independent corroboration.
